episode.episode: 7-17-26 - Hour 4 - How will the new 5 and 5 rule affect college football recruiting and BYU football?
episode.showDescription: Cougar Sports with Ben Criddle (@criddlebenjamin) keeps you up-to-date on all things BYU Sports. We not only cover football & basketball, but we dive into recruiting, baseball, soccer, and more. For insight that you can't get anywhere else, tune into 103.9/ 98.3 FM. Monday-Friday from 2-6 PM MST. Follow us on social media @espnthefan & interact with us using #ESPNTheFan.

transcript_window.text: And even if they say they do, what they're hoping is that they'll convince you.
They'll say, oh, yeah, we're going to support you, but play one year first.
And they're hoping they can convince you to stay and not go on a mission.
I mean, we heard from Peyton Higginson last hour.
He said he talked about that.
You asked him the question, and he brought up a certain college, right?
That's just the nature of what it is.
And we've heard from many recruits that have come to BYU that have signed Ben or even gone elsewhere, they've said, yeah, they don't want you going on a mission.
They want you to get in now and want you to play.
And that makes sense, but it improves your point.
